title: Excellent
body: I use this to track my health (supplements, workouts etc) and I find it perfect. Very intuitive. Just one “but”, I’d like the option of creating multiple “pages” or collections of tracking. For example, I track my workouts and supplements but also my dog’s supplements and it would be useful to have like page 1 - my tracking and page 2 - his tracking. Just a suggestion. Thank you for reading
